title: Companion unavailable-node disclosure
description: Use the existing private native profile fixture; no inference or node state changes are performed.

ready.intent: Unavailable execution nodes have a single disclosure while the healthy local workspace remains usable.

collapsed.intent: Unrelated execution-node failures are hidden by default and do not disable local conversation creation.

reveal.intent: Reach the compact unavailable-node disclosure through native scrolling.

capture-collapsed.intent: Record the compact setup screen without the repeated failure list.

expand.intent: Inspect execution-node diagnostics only after explicitly expanding them.

expanded.intent: Expanded details match the actual unavailable nodes reported by the gateway.

capture-expanded.intent: Record the optional diagnostic details in the native interface.

collapse.intent: Hide diagnostic details and return to a compact setup view.

verify-collapsed.intent: The disclosure closes without changing the selected healthy workspace or launching a session.
